- Week 1–2: integration + smoke tests + core evaluation prompts
- Week 3: stress/latency/cost checks + anomaly review
- Week 4: acceptance review + decision meeting

If that looks reasonable I can convert the doc to a co-edit GDoc and drop in a proposed calendar for your team.
